statusDetail: The origin resolved to 164.100.69.3, but the server reset the TLS connection before returning an HTTP response. Chrome showed ERR_CONNECTION_RESET on repeated desktop, mobile, dark-mode, crawler, header, HAR, and layout attempts; curl independently reported “Recv failure: Connection reset by peer”.

page.notes: No application response was received, so framework, templates, and representative routes could not be identified.

artifacts.caption: Chrome ERR_CONNECTION_RESET at the requested origin on desktop.
Chrome ERR_CONNECTION_RESET at the requested origin on mobile.
Chrome ERR_CONNECTION_RESET under dark color preference.
DOM capture contains Chrome’s network error interstitial, not the target application.
Raw fetch failed and browser navigation reached the connection-reset interstitial.
Rendered-browser discoverability view shows connection reset.
Crawler view produced no target document because the origin connection failed.
DNS and curl diagnostics showing TLS connection reset by peer.
Header primitive could not observe a target response; apparent missing headers are not judged.
HAR of failed origin requests and browser-owned error-page assets.
HAR summary showing failed document requests; browser error assets must not be attributed to the site.
Layout of Chrome’s error interstitial, retained only as blocker evidence and not site-quality evidence.
